title: calendars-server memory: onSuccessSetIsDefault changes no visible state
description: Found during JMAP-y1yu.10 (2026-11-16). MemoryBackend::set_default_calendar (and likely set_default_participant_identity) only moves AccountAux::default_calendar. Calendar/set with onSuccessSetIsDefault: "cal2" answers updated {cal2: {isDefault: true}} but newState is unchanged and Calendar/get still returns isDefault false for every Calendar: the pointer is never reflected in the stored objects or /get, and the Calendar state is not bumped. draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-34 §4.3: the server sets isDefault true on the new default and false on the previous one, a change clients see in Calendar/get and /changes. Fix: update both stored objects' isDefault (or derive isDefault from the pointer in get_objects) and record the change in the change log/state; same for ParticipantIdentity (§3.3). Tests: /set then /get shows exactly one default; /changes lists both ids.
